claim.summary: For a nonempty finite multiset of complex points rho = beta + i gamma with polynomial F and real h: |F(h+s)| > |F(h+1-conj(s))| for all Re s > 1/2 iff every beta <= 1/2 + h and some beta < 1/2 + h. The proof is the identity |h+s-rho|^2 - |h+1-conj(s)-rho|^2 = (2 sigma - 1)(2h + 1 - 2 beta).
claim.assessment: Working elementary proof. The same identity is the step in Lagarias's Lemma 2.1 (arXiv math/0601653), so on that source's product formula the de Branges structure-function condition for xi(1/2 + h - iz) holds exactly when xi has no zero with real part above 1/2 + h; unconditional for h >= 1/2, and never for h <= 0. Shows the Hermite-Biehler lead's defining inequality on the whole half-plane is the zero-free statement at each positive shift; at a single point it is weaker. Inner-product conditions on the associated space are not examined.

formalization.scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

significance.rationale: Shows that the modulus inequality at a fixed positive shift is the zero-free statement; the lead stays open on the consequence side (zeros of the sum functions) and the inner-product conditions.
significance.next_action: Quantify the count of off-line zeros of the sum function for a finite configuration with k points right of the shifted line, and decide the converse.

relationships.note: Companion of the logarithmic derivative sign criteria; both are forms of the zero-free statement.

claim.summary: For a nonempty finite multiset R with Phi(s) = sum m_rho/(s - rho): all Re rho <= sigma_0 iff Re Phi > 0 on Re s > sigma_0. For real points Gamma and one conjugate pair gamma +- i delta of multiplicity m, the Laguerre expression L(x) = sum m_w/(x - w)^2 on the real line is negative at x = gamma iff sum over Gamma of m'/(gamma - gamma')^2 < 2m/delta^2, the pair's term is at least -2m/delta^2 and negative only for |x - gamma| < delta, and L >= 0 everywhere when the real points have gaps at most 2 delta/sqrt(m) covering (gamma - delta, gamma + delta).
claim.assessment: Working elementary proofs. The half-plane sign criterion is equivalent to the zero-free statement at every boundary, so it is not a weaker premise; the local real-line (Laguerre, phase-monotonicity) condition cannot fail for an off-line pair farther from the line than half the gap of the real points around it times sqrt(m), while the global count of real zeros detects every pair and is the goal's statement. Finite configurations only; part (a) is the finite model of a known equivalence and no novelty is claimed; the general Hermite-Biehler and de Branges sources are not read.

formalization.scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

significance.rationale: Shows for finite configurations that the Hermite-Biehler lead's two natural forms are the goal's statement and a criterion blind in the relevant range.
significance.next_action: Read a source on structure functions of de Branges type for xi and state which condition is equivalent to the goal and what is known unconditionally.
